title: Event Ingest Orchestrator and Schema Harmonizer
creator: Marco Liu
description: Build an orchestrator service that centralizes usage event ingestion, enforces a compact harmonized schema, and provides pluggable validators for downstream analytics and billing. This ticket covers the backend service, API contract, concurrency/backpressure behavior, and a lightweight compatibility shim for legacy event producers. Goal is to reduce failed-parsing alerts by 90% and cut downstream schema-variant handling code in the analytics pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: New orchestrator accepts events from HTTP and gRPC producers and normalizes to the agreed canonical schema
Schema harmonizer supports field-level versioning and clear error codes for producers
Deployed service emits telemetry: ingest.success, ingest.reject, ingest.transform.latency, and schema.version-mapping metrics
Backward-compatibility shim converts top 3 legacy event shapes with <200ms p95 additional latency
E2E test harness validates at least 10 representative producer shapes; nightly regression test passes
No increase in prod error budget; SLO: 99.5% successful ingest over rolling 30d after rollout

decision_log: Adopt JSON Schema for canonical form with a small rule engine for field-level harmonization. Avoid immediate protobuf migration to keep producer onboarding fast. Use per-field 'schema_version' metadata and a mapping table stored in Config service. Transformers will run inlined in the orchestrator for top-3 legacy shapes; everything else will be rejected with actionable error codes.
notes: We will throttle transformation work to preserve latency SLOs; heavy transformations must be opt-in via migration flag. Consider a future work item to offload complex transforms to a streaming worker pool.
monitoring_and_runbook: Runbook created and attached; key playbooks: 1) increase transformer pool size, 2) toggle strict-mode to 'warn' for producers, 3) rollback to pass-through mode. See attachments for runbook link.
migration_plan: Phase 1: deploy orchestrator in pass-through mode with metrics and rejects logged. Phase 2: enable harmonizer for top-3 producers by config flag. Phase 3: require canonical format and deprecate legacy paths with 30d notices. Communicate via #prod-ingest and producer migration doc.
post_rollout_checks: no new billing mismatches in reconciliation job
consumer downstream jobs process at baseline latency
